notes.title: Source code release!
notes.notes:
Just made the source code for Racingmaybe open source here in case anyone would want to mod or contribute to the project!! Instructions are included 😁 Enjoy!
https://github.com/jhoffis/Racingmaybe_open/

notes.title: Update 49: It's animated
notes.notes:
Added some smooth background animations.
 Made upgrade tiles now have animations when you hover or click them.
 Added a hand animation for when you buy stuff.
 Added a resign button to multiplayer.
 Improved distinction in the win scene.
 Added a udp scanner which now automatically adds local hosted games to the multiplayer lobby browser.
 Added placement weight to Turbo, Supercharger, and Lighter Pistons.
 Made Tireboost Heater unlock Block.
 Added a "Hyper Board" which is a change of your board from 5x5 to 7x7. This is unlocked when you have unlocked all empty tiles.
 Added "Pattern Upgrades" or "Hyper Upgrades" which are upgrades that are unlocked when you unlock the "Hyper Board."
 Changed the tool "Merchant" so that it also places -1% sale on all tiles surrounding it every turn.
 Made deceleration/wind resistance more realistic in that the resistance is the same whether you throttle or not. Previously it decelerated 80% less when holding down the throttle compared to letting go.

notes.title: Update 48
notes.notes:
Fixed an exploit found by DX and Anime Michael where by placing a Neighbor Tunnel and a Dilator they would get billions of dollars.
 Fixed Neighbor Collector being able to scale turbo blow strength way more than intentional.
 Added a discord button to the start screen.
 Added a show replays in explorer button to the replays list.

notes.title: Update 47.1
notes.notes:
Fixed stability of the algorithm for calculating max LVLs
 Made Neighbor Tunnel also transfer LVLs to the max LVL algorithm. Although upgrades passing through the tunnel only transfer 25% of their LVL.

notes.title: Update 47
notes.notes:
Better beginner introduction/tutorial.
 Fixed some more multiplayer issues like ghost lobbies.
 Made neighboring tiles more visually understandable.
 Fixed money issues with leadout and especially hardcore-leadout.
 Added more first-to gamemodes.
 Made Mattress, Punctured Tire and Cracked Manifold worse.
 Changed Decentra from 133 HP -> 135 HP and reduced their Turbo Blow Strength from 300% to 200%.
 Drastically improved usability of Neighbor Tunnel. It will now tunnel neighbor bonuses to adjecent tiles as well as their neighbors, and also to themselves, which is kind of strange. Dilator also doubles the neighboring bonuses of those that go through the tunnel now.
 Made Permanentifier remove one random LVL from any of their neighboring tiles.
 In replay, you can now scroll back and forth by rounds as well.
 Pressing ESC and "giving in" (DNF) now no longer destroys your economy but places you at last place instead.
 Balanced max income of leadout a bit more.
 Introduced 2 new singleplayer challenges: Sensei and Harder!
 Added a LVL 3 bonus to NOS Bottle which gives -10% nos but +250 nos ms.
 Increased Tireboost change after upgrade from +0.15 to +0.2 tb.
 Tweaked the rest of Tireboost bonuses.
 Added a LVL 4 bonus to Tireboost Heater which gives between +5% to +20% tb.

notes.title: Update 46
notes.notes:
Now you get to DRIVE with actual hands and a steering wheel (GRAPHICS!!!! Not an actual real physical steering wheel... That wouldn't even make any sense since you never need to steer your car in this game), and with animations when you shift gears!
 Now when you look behind you in a race, you look through a ugly mirror instead of nothing.
 Fixed the gearbox so that now if you shift down and no speed is lost then it won't lag the shifting input.
 Fixed some multiplayer bugs that were annoying!! (hopefully)
 Introduced 3 new singleplayer challenges: Samurai, Accomplished and The Boss!
 Added 1 new Tool called Yunomah, which acts like neighboring Tools. Might be overpowered.
 Added the chatbox to the win-screen.
 Added a few more gamemodes to multiplayer. Small ones like a 5-round Total gamemode. No biggie.
 Gave Tireboost a new bonus at LVL 15 which increases TB Heat.
 Buffed Tireboost Heater's neighbor bonus from 25% -> 33% tb only.
 Buffed Tireboost Heater's change per tile placement to +0.25 heat.
 Nerfed Block's change per tile placement from +5 -> +10 kg.
 Nerfed Block's change per tile placement from +25 -> +20 HP.

https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZTZkZzBmOTFjenV3N3VqYTN6c2NtOHpvbDd4MnNxYWx3dW01ZGV2YSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/13iD1PZTbmglAQ/giphy.gif

notes.title: Update 45
notes.notes:
Buffed Seeper, Neighbor Collector and rotators.
 Added new tiles Left Rotator and Tireboost Heater.
 Added new element called "heat" which can be gained through the new tile Tireboost Heater. Heat basically scales your tireboost, but is expended each turn based on how much tireboost was active and yellow.
 Added sandbox mode to singleplayer.
 Fixed bug where small percentages rounded to closest whole number.
 Fixed Dilator.

notes.title: Update 44
notes.notes:
Made timesmod or the x? thing have a stronger color blending, because colors are nice.
Added a "sales mechanic" where now there will be a randomly placed -25% sale on the board which means that tiles placed here and improved here will cost 25% less. 
This should make the gameplay a little deeper and interesting, maybe.

notes.title: Update 43.3
notes.notes:
Fixed some bugs
 Nerfed neighbor bonus of Weight Reduction and increased Lighter Pistons neighbor bonus.
 Split LVL 10 bonus into LVL 7 and 10 for Tireboost.
 Moved LVL 10 bonus to LVL 7 and reduced price from $1200 to $1000 for Lighter Pistons.
 Made Mega Unfair more difficult.

notes.title: Update 43.2
notes.notes:
Nerfed "Seeper"'s attitude towards percentages where now it initially spreads 2% and increases by 1% instead of 10% and 5%.
 Improved explaination or tooltip for "Seeper."
 Added a button where you can run or activate the tool "Rotator" for $200. There might be some situations where this would be useful.

notes.title: Update 43.1
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where the store tiles are wrong in Classic game-mode.
 Added a Medium Total mode.
 Made Total and Leadout have the same price every game so it's easier to think out strategies.
 Balanced singleplayer challenges a bit more, especially Mega Unfair.
 Made tireboost effect during races now visualize the amount of time left of the boost similarly to nos bottles.
 Improved singleplayer scoring for when lives are part of the challenge.

notes.title: Update 43
notes.notes:
Made the background of the lobby/store more pleasant.
 And made open tiles nicer to look at.
 Replaced the graphics for the tiles Tireboost and NOS.
 Replaced the sound effect for weight reduction.
 Replaced the sound effect for rotating your car selection.
 Added sound effects for using your nos bottles.
 Now you earn more money from going fast and beat-time is always increased maximally for the next round.
 Neighbour Tunnel now works on all of the tools.
 Buffed tool Merchant from placing $3x to $4x, and upper limit of sellprice increase is now $3000 instead of $1000.
 Buffed tool Permnanetifier by making it disperse LVLs around to connected neighbors.
 Nerfed NOS Bottle neighbor bonus from +0.5% nos to +0.25% nos.
 Nerfed Lighter Pistons neighbor bonus from +1% HP to +0.5% HP.
 Changed Lighter Pistons by removing its first bonus but lowering its Sticky Clutch bonus from LVL 15 to LVL 10 but increasing the price of this bonus from $50 to $1200.
 Changed Tireboost by lowering its latest bonus from LVL 15 to LVL 10 but removed its forth option.
 Added a new negative tile called Cracked Manifold which gives -10% nos and tireboost to its neighbors.
 Made a new map for Mega Unfair and moved the old Mega Unfair map to Unfair and the Unfair map to Legendary.
 Added a tile to Beginner to maybe make it even easier for noobs to understand, hopefully.
 Changed many small things for every single singleplayer challenge so now it should be more fun and easier to win lower challenges, but the later challenges are even more cancer (in a good way.)
 Improved the leaderboards by showing which round the player won and what time he/she got.
 Also now the leaderboards should show the right name every time.
 Fixed many bugs in multiplayer so hopefully it will desync less. It is so difficult to fix these multiplayer bugs man.
 Made race lights slightly visible from the start.
 Made race lights show up 5 times instead of 3 and instead of the interval between each bulb being random it is now equal but faster. This is inspired by Dragster's fast countdown and play.
 Hovering a tile over an empty tile will no longer show which times mod is hiding under, rather it will show which LVL it requires to have in a surrounding tile to unlock.

notes.title: Update 42
notes.notes:
Remade networking backend. Should be way more stable now, but of course this code is brand new so there may be some ninja bugs hiding.
 Improved graphics and tried to make racing more beautiful.
 Nerfed NOS, Lighter Pistons, and Seeper.
 Fixed many bugs like braking while in neutral.
 Made a custom board for Master, Nightmarish, Unfair and Mega Unfair.
 Made tutorial/information about the game easier to access and understand.

notes.title: Update 41
notes.notes:
Improved tooltips and corrected wrong information.
 Introduced new singleplayer challenge called Master because there was a kink in the percentage of players finishing Hard and Expert.
 Dark corners when traveling fast will no longer suddenly appear at like 230 kmh but gradually appear.
 Tachometer will now show the right numbers. For instance, it presented the Thoroughbred as having 6000 RPM but it starts with 5000 RPM.
 Removed terrible FOV effect when going fast!
 Increased speed of the gif in the singleplayer menu.
 Impossible and Mega-Impossible are now called Unfair and Mega Unfair because people thought the game-modes were actually impossible.
 Made the unfair modes more "interesting"
 Improved the controller experience (and fixed most of its bugs)
 Fixed the bar stats that show up when you race so that it actually shows the right number. And also it shows what it is in HP.
 Objectives now show up after you enter the win-scene.
 Selling Tools now give you 3 improvement-points back! Could allow for more strategies.
 Fixed tiles with tiles-mod (x?) being gray if you have an external monitor connected.
 Added tint (visual weather) to your car and road (not just the sky and skyline like it used to be)
 Fixed gearing bugs with controller.
 Made tiles go gray if they're not a neighbor or the tile you're hovering over.

notes.title: Update 40
notes.notes:
Added 3 modes of Coop to play with your friends!
 Added support for controllers! Just plug it in and enjoy!
 Made it possible to look at opponents boards when playing by hovering over their icons!
 Hotkeys can now be edited and specified!
 Better performance!
 It's now easier to rejoin a game as any current game will be listed in the game lobby with a STARTED prefix.
 For LAN, the game will now remember the last IP you wrote.
 Made the chat-box support many more characters like "æøå" and also it does not cut words in half when it wants to add a new line.
 Fixed tb penalty and snos being too OP!
 Added Designer-Notes where I try to explain some of the game-mechanics in the game.
 Added some explanation for what is happening in Total so that people aren't as confused when opponents get extra points and the game does not immediately end.
 Made the game scale more properly for wide-screen or square monitors.
 Cleaned up the TAB-window where you see the general stats of the players.
 Made the clutch-in-sfx more pleasant.
 Fixed the gear lever not entering its slot properly sometimes.
 Added more info and stats to replays.
 Added negative tile Mattress.
 Nerfed Interest tile.
 Fixed all memory leaks.
 Added sandbox mode.
 Fixed commentator mode.
 Fixed First-to game-mode.

notes.title: Update 39a
notes.notes:
Hotfix:

 Fixed scoring algorithm.
 Fixed tools not showing proper values in the replay.
 Added achieved money and points to replay.

notes.title: Update 39
notes.notes:
Added a frame-limiter and a fuse for 1285 error and vsync. Default setting is now 300 fps and no vsync instead of unlimited fps and vsync.
 Added tool Permanentifier which removes values from neighboring tiles so that you lose less when selling them. Removes 10% each turn.
 Made racing hints more dynamic and helpful.
 Reintroduced game-rules to car-choice-scene in beginner mode.
 Forgot to say that in Update 38 supercharger sound effect was introduced. In this update it has been reduced in volume as it was a bit too piercing.
 More explainations of Tireboost.
 Buffed the tool Merchant where it now reduces the timesmod that is lost when selling a neighboring upgrade on a tile with x1 or less from -0.2x -> -0.1x
 Now you can buy 1 turbo even though you have placed 3 superchargers always.
 Shaders that have been destroyed can no longer be extra destroyed.

notes.title: Update 38
notes.notes:
Fixed infinite money bug in Leadout-mode and Time-mode
 Fixed a rare bug regarding a multiplayer mismatch.
 Improved chatbox by making it possible to write long messages and have it automatically go to the next line.
 Made OpenGL not make any calls while the window is resizing.
 Added a taunt

notes.title: Update 37
notes.notes:
There are still some things that I would like to fix etc, but this is how far I got! Enjoy :)


 Animated image in singleplayer menu.
 Updated main menu background image.
 Added a effect of striped roads if you finish faster than 10,000 kmh which is too fast for the frames.
 Made the goal go wider when you have more than 4, 8 and 12 players. It used to just grow and grow until the goalposts were like a skyscraper.
 Added initial negative tiles called Birds Nest, Broken Window, Grinded Gears and Punctured Tire:
 Birds Nest reduce HP of neighbors.
 Broken Window adds aero to neighbors.
 Grinded Gears reduces top speed of neighbors.
 Punctured Tire reduces boost-time of neighbors.
 These negative tiles can be removed for a mere $150! Enjoy >:) mohaha
 Added a Tool called Merchant which adds money to the layer over time and gradually scales the money you get for selling tiles around.
 Added another Tool called Rotator which moves neighboring tiles around each turn.
 Made colors of the gear lever less harsh.
 Made colors of tiles on a timesmod (x2 etc.) have the tint of the quality and also have a less foggy look. Makes it easier to see.
 Made colors in the win-screen more appealing
 Added many more taunts.
 Added the sound of air/wind when you drive.
 Done some things to try to get multiplayer more stable. It is more stable, but it might not be perfect.
 Added a better functionality for kicking players. The host can now click on a player and a promt will appear.
 Fixed (and kinda nerfed) throttle reengaging if you grind a gear by not ever releasing your throttle and then letting go of the lever. This actually made it possible to not lose any speed but your ears would bleed as a result. It was actually a very good nos or tb meta.
 Bonuses now have different prices. For instance, dog-box and sequential now cost $300 instead of $50.
 Set max amount of players to 16.
 Set max username length to 128 characters instead of 16.
 Made non-ascii characters of usernames be automatically replaced by a ?
 Made it possible to scroll through the result of players in finish.
 Added explaination of income in finish.
 Added "Darn fast time attack" which is where you have to drive under 0.3 seconds.
 Fixed No-Upgrade gamemode not actually being equal in their upgrades. 
 Added 9 fun, weird and tough random challenges to singleplayer.
 Made Impossible and Mega-Impossible possible and actually quite interesting. For instance, I have removed lifes and replaced it with -2 attempts and also the map does not change so that you can make a strategy or plan.
 Added an achievement for Mega-Impossible.
 Made scoring in singleplayer more easy to understand. You get 10,000,000 points for each attempt left, up to 50,000,000 score based on how fast you were compared to the win-time (down to half the win-time), and up to 10,000,000 score from your money achieved.
 You can now undo (and redo) all your progress this turn in singleplayer. In multiplayer you can still only undo one move - so that people don't have to wait forever.
 Added SNOS which is basically super nos which inverts aero to your nos but uses two bottles instead of one. This is found in a new bonus at LVL 7 in N O S.

https://media.giphy.com/media/1rSQ2dv8uJEEvd9AlR/giphy.gif

notes.title: Next update coming soon...
notes.notes:
I'm thinking the next update is going to be released the 17. december.
There will be a lot of fixes and a lot of goodies. For instance up to 16 player support for you mad-lads, and a way "better" singleplayer for you loner-enjoyers.

notes.title: Update 36a
notes.notes:
Fixed FirstTo game-mode always getting shorter and shorter track
 Made singleplayer challenges show attempts left instead of points on the right
 Added some text at the main menu

notes.title: Update 36
notes.notes:
Added a taunt 36.
 Added two new game-modes called "Total: No Upgrading" and "Time attack".
 Track-lengths in Total and First-to are no longer extremely long and boring.
 Made below x1 tiles slowly regenerate towards x1 by 0.05 each turn.
 Can no longer sell your way to negative horsepower nor weight.
 Win-screen is now slightly more interesting (You get to see your car twice wow)
 Reduced memory leaks...
 In singleplayer you can now only lose half a heart if you only have 3 or less attempts/points left.


https://media.giphy.com/media/9kxYKMlIbl6jKVz2oj/giphy.gif

notes.title: Update 35e
notes.notes:
Made track-length algorithm aim at slowest player rather than the fastest.
 Fixed track-length showing the wrong length after having finished a race.
 Made Tools need more improvements over time.
 Made hidden info about turbo visible.

notes.title: Update 35d
notes.notes:
Buffed Decentra
 Buffed Oldsroyal
 Buffed Fabulvania
 Nerfed Thoroughbred
 Fixed some bugs so it does not crash all the time
 Improved a little length of tracks
 Changed Money Pit bonus to be not trash
 Nerfed Tireboost LVL 5 bonus except for second choice
 Buffed Seeper so that it has a 15% chance of spawning percent neighbor values instead of decimals instead of 5%
 Nerfed Weight bonus from max -20% to -12% kg

notes.title: Update 35c
notes.notes:
Fixed rejoining bugs.
 Fixed a rare bug where a LAN thread would get stuck.
 Fixed a bug where whenever you clicked it would write which monitor you're using to disk.
 Fixed a bug where there game would crash for the other players if you chose a random car and did a undo.
 Fixed Turbo Blow getting depleted way faster than intended.
 Fixed so replays can no longer save states that are corrupt.
 Buffed Times Mod Planter so that it now plants 0.1 per turn on itself as well as the 0.2 around.
 Improved track-length algorithm for Leadout so it now adjusts to how fast you're driving instead of blindly guessing.
 Now in Leadout if you're 1 point away from losing the game and you win a race you get 1 additional point
 Improved stats when finishing a race in the singleplayer challenges
 Improved bonus of the last NOS Bottle so that you can now also choose to get +2 bottles
 Added a bonus to Turbo at LVL 3 which reduces spool-speed but increases Turbo Blow
 Added some more tooltips here and there

notes.title: Update 35b
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where in multiplayer any message would overflow an important buffer.
 Increased max-income in multiplayer from $200 per turn to $250 per turn.
 Made penalty for being slower than your opponent by 5 seconds less harsh generally, but in extreme cases, worse.
 Fixed the OP bonus, at the 15th Lighter Pistons tile, called "Sticky Clutch" by making it, as it was originally intended, more powerful. Basically it would previously act as if the tachometer was pointing at the original top rpm, but now it will actually point at the highest possible rpm. Behind the scenes of course.
 Buffed the bonus for having 5 block tiles by removing the additional kg you would get, so now you only get HP.

notes.title: Update 35
notes.notes:
General changes:

 Added many more taunts
 Fixed some misspelling here and there
 The map now has money spread out randomly, this could be interesting
 TAB now shows how much money the opponents have
 The countdown in multiplayer will now pause at every 10th second instead of resetting to 180 seconds
 Now possible to look behind you while racing by pressing R
 One can also Quick-Sell a tile by using Ctrl+S instead of S
 Though selling now makes tiles worse even below x1. Previously the lowest a tile could go was x1 but now it is x0.1. Timesmod Planters will reset these tiles instantly to x1 though so yeah
 Added a background behind the map and made background colors more vibrant
 Fixed the game crashing if you got 10 gears
 Fixed many other things

Upgrade changes:

 Your car can no longer be negative drag coefficient
 Moved upgrade-value rpm-idle from Aero to Power
 Nerfed Aero upgrade from -10% aero to -5% and its bonus from -50% to -33%
 Nerfed Interest to +5% interest
 Nerfed tb ms of all cars by -10%
 Nerfed Weight Reduction upgrade from -3% kg to -2%
 Nerfed Lighter Pistons from +2% HP to +1%
 Nerfed Lighter Pistons bonus LVL 15 from -50% HP to -75% HP
 Nerfed Turbo from +0.6 bar to +0.4 bar
 Nerfed Turbo Blow and made it more dependent on the Turbo upgrade
 Nerfed Turbo neighboring values from +4% turbo blow regen to +2%, and +2% bar is switched to +0.25 turbo blow strength
 Nerfed Supercharger from +1 bar to +0.8 bar
 Nerfed Block LVL 5 bonus from being +200, +400, +800 HP to +160, +400, +800 HP
 Nerfed Neighbor Collector from +100% every round to +25%
 Buffed Seeper from +10% initially and +5% otherwise to +20% initially and +10% otherwise, and added a 5% chance of spawning values as percentages
 Buffed late-game Tireboost by adding a bonus to LVL 15: +3%, +6%, +10%, +15% tb
 Now every Tool you buy increases the price of said tool a little more than every other (the price of all tools increases nonetheless)
 Empty tiles can now be unlocked if a adjecent tile is improved and reaches LVL 9 or above. Perhaps the empty tile was hiding a treasure all along? 

Sound changes:

 Made deceleration sound better and two step actually cut ignition early like in real life
 Replaced the single engine sound effect with weak, normal and powerful engine sounds
 Fixed no idle-sound when starting a race
 The engine now has a minimum sound volume of 60% instead of 0%

https://media.tenor.com/t6GA7VbBi8AAAAAd/jeremy-jeremy-clarkson.gif

notes.title: Update 34
notes.notes:
Added the Seeper which will "seep" base-values into others neighboring-values making it possible to create more weird strategies like idk converting Gears tiles into nos scaling beasts?
Added randomly placed empty tiles to increase replayablitity.
Nerfed NOS ms by -50% because my god its OPPP!
Increased windresistance so that buying Aero is actually useful.
Increased cost of Dialator
Made a maximum income limit to the game-modes Leadout and First-To so that you cannot scale income into infinity and ruin the match for the other racers. This limit changes every round and is written under the Objectives tab in the gamelobby.

notes.title: Update 33
notes.notes:
Added Mega Impossible
 Made singleplayer less punishing for driving fast - and losing by less than 250 ms.
 Possible to only lose half a heart
 Possible to choose a random car! SO RANDOM AHAH
 Better tooltips that now tell you available bonuses (again)
 Changed upgrades a bit so they are more interesting
 Made the Expert challenge more interesting
 Fixed many multiplayer bugs
 Added replay functionality so you can rewatch the choices you made and share them if you so desire. 
 Added info of the last race under each player in the TAB-player-list
 Made the options menu better
 Gave the Decentra +5 HP because it is so slow, man!
 Changed a few textures when racing so that their pixel scale is better



https://media.giphy.com/media/WcHGCCI2ybpVy25L1y/giphy.gif

notes.title: Update 32
notes.notes:
Made singleplayer challenge list automatically update
 Added an upgrade called "Interest"
 And also "Supercharger" which is a less powerful but more speedy version of "Turbo."
 Singleplayer challenges now have hearts to show how many lifes you have left.
 Fixed some bugs.
 Made all gamemodes a bit more interesting. Including the singleplayer gamemodes.

notes.title: Update 31
notes.notes:
Made beginner and casual more introductory, rather than just very easy.
 Made Impossible slightly less cancer by adding a bonus to Money Pit LVL 3 where you can get more lives. It does have a visual error where under objectives it does not register these new lives, but trust me, they're there.
 Turbo upgrade is 25% stronger.

notes.title: Update 30
notes.notes:
Added more achievements
 Made some challenges more "interesting"
 Balanced cars more


https://i.imgur.com/Hqilw2p.png

notes.title: Update 29
notes.notes:
Now up to 8 players
 Improved multiplayer stability
 Made challenges score lists more nice looking
 Fixed enemy cars not moving

https://i.imgur.com/l99yvwd.png

notes.title: Update 28
notes.notes:
General fixes and improvements:

 Updated fonts.
 Improved shaders for when placing and upgrading tiles.
 Bettered explanations and tool-tips.
 Fixed or at least minimized memory leak from new music being loaded.
 Fixed a lot of bugs which should now make multiplayer more stable.
 Now visualizing when and how to unlock the Tools.

Car changes:

 Decentra 5->4 gears.
 Oldsroyal 4->3 gears.
 Fabulvania 6->5 gears.
 Made so you do not lose half your speed when shifting and then barely touching a lower gear.
 Added possibility to get more gears by upgrading gears. From 3 to 9 in fact.
 Brake pedal no longer gets stuck when pushed.
 Brake pedal also now actually brakes.
 Turbo Blow now can regenerate above 100%.

Upgrade changes:

 Added new upgrade called Aero. It removes high speed penalty and improves overall RPM with neighbours.
 Renamed Subprime to Finance.
 Now you can sell a tile and buy it back, but the price stays high and you cannot redo bonuses.
 Added a minimum bar bonus to Turbo LVL 3.
 Changed Turbo bonus LVL 5 to be better.
 Weight now has max-LVL of 4 instead of infinite.
 Weight can now not remove more than -50% kg.
 Nos Bottles can no longer be placed next to Nos Bottles.
 Clutch base values now gives +4% km/h instead of +2%.
 Clutch neighbours now get +15 km/h instead of +12.5.
 Added Two-Step unlock to Clutch LVL 3 bonus which allows the player to hold down the throttle and not get any penalty.
 Gears now gives a gear when placed
 Gears changes with +15 km/h for each new tile instead of +7.5.
 Gears neighbours can now recieve its bonus where before only Clutch and Gears could recieve it. (The neighbour bonus is +1% km/h)


https://c.tenor.com/XPgoGKB_8GcAAAAd/abel-abel-elegante.gif

notes.title: Update 26+27
notes.notes:
Now in Leadout if you're behind by 5 seconds you lose 25% of your $ per turn, and 25% if behind 10 seconds.
 Fixed incorrect dragging of gear lever when driving Oldsroyal.
 Now Power only unlocks Block. Also Block->Weight and Lighter Pistons
 Bonuses now cost 50x instead of 75x.
 Made singleplayer challenges easier/less bullshit.
 Removed dog-box and sequential from Decentra, but added +6 HP.
 Fabulvania +15 kg and -0.1 nos, but +200 nos ms.
 Thoroughbred -1 hp.
 Added wind (which makes shifting early game much easier and late game a little harder)
 Made Neighbor Collector grow by 100% per turn instead of 50%
 Made top speed a much more rare resource (as it was too easy to upgrade too much top speed and ruin your car).
 Added back "You have lost" soundbite.


https://media.giphy.com/media/Zi4jG380TxmXbzfHjd/giphy.gif

notes.title: Update 25
notes.notes:
Added more gamemodes
 Nerfed Weight
 Changed redline/grind punishment from -80% spdinc to -70%

notes.title: Update 24
notes.notes:
Might have fixed a rare bug that crashes the game while racing.

Btw, listen to this cool song:
https://youtu.be/hO3ZHfD5SoI

notes.title: Update 22+23
notes.notes:
Added 4 new so-called "tools" that do different interesting things. One collects neighboring bonuses, one plants timesmod, one doubles neighboring bonuses and the last one tunnels neighboring bonuses to other places on the board.
 Redrawn many icons.

notes.title: Update 9

New Features

Upgrade Tiles
Added three new upgrades called Power, Boost, and Supplementary! These cost $90 each and unlock further upgrades like so:
Power
Max lvl: 1
+30 kW
No neighbour values.
Unlocks Weight, Turbo and Beefy Block.
Boost
Max lvl: 1
No upgrade values.
No neighbour values.
But choose between "+1 nos bottle & -2 gold" or "+0.2 tb & +1 gold"
Unlocks Tireboost and N O S.
Supplementary
Max lvl: 1
+10 km/h and +10 v$
No neighbour values.
Unlocks Clutch and Money Pit.
Clutch
Now unlocks Gears
N O S
Nerfed from +0.4 nos to +0.3
Buffed LVL 5 Bonus option from -60% sale off Tireboost to -70%
Weight
Increases -1% kg per tile instead of -0.5% kg
Nerfed LVL 4 Bonus from 
"Beefy Block no longer increases weight" vs. "Beefy Block +4% kg instead" to
"Beefy Block +2% kg instead" vs "Beefy Block +6% kg instead"
Nerfed LVL 6 Bonus option from "Clutch gets -8% kg" to -5% kg.
Buffed LVL 12 Bonus option from -10% kg to -15% kg.
Unlocks Fuel and Lighter Pistons

Can be bought indefinitely now.
Buffed from base +6% kW to +8% kW.
Turbo
Neighbour value is now +0.1 bar instead of +30 kW

Neighbour value is now +2% kW instead of +50 kW or +2%kW

Money Pit
Improved sound effect and made less prone to ruin your game by locking out the last Fuel bonus.
Cars

Decentra
Nerfed tb ms from 1200ms to 900ms
Fabulvania
Nerfed tb ms from 1200ms to 900ms
Thoroughbred
Nerfed tb ms from 800ms to 700ms
General Bugfixes

- Fixed sometimes pressing the gearlever made it jump into second gear.

Sooon, Update 9 will come and bring forth bugfixes.. Lots of bugfixes!

Additionally, there will be more stats at the end of each game. This will make it possible to see and understand each move your opponent chose before you destroyed their ass! (Pun intended)

It should also be easier for the noobs out there to decide what tile to purchase as there are generally fewer to choose from at any time! This means there are 3 starter tiles of which unfold into more tiles. These tiles are called Power, Boost and Supplementary.

Anyway, I work on this project basically everyday, so I'm sorry for the lack of updates, but I just want this version to be playable in the sense that it does not break in the middle of a match, as that is ultra annoying!

notes.title: Update 4 is out!
notes.notes:
Update 4 is out and it comes with many changes!
First and foremost, I have to say that the C++ engine I wrote about in the previous two posts will be used for my next game instead of Racingmaybe. That being said, I'm glad I started that project and I have a few interesting ideas for it. Anyways, here are the changes:

 Shifting is now done by the mouse.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345629/730a9bc858906b69ecc36c8240303877fedc6687.png

 A goal will now be present in the races. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345629/b54a43d99d9bdb686ef45c77fd1ce146c8d9d0d8.png
 No longer places you inside of your opponents car in multiplayer. Instead, you can now see and race against a opponent in real-time in a race.
 Clutch and brake is removed.
 Upgrade / Lobby is massively clearified.
 Proper step-by-step tutorial now present in "Options and Controls"
 Possible to change between fullscreen and windowed.
 Moving the game in windowed mode to another monitor will resize the window it its proper dimension.
 Changed font for a better one.
 Added some more sound effects.
 Losing now possible in singleplayer.
 Win condition now shown after game has begun as well.
 Bonuses better formatted (Lines are tabbed and spaced differently)
 Fabulvania now has wheels
 Functioning scrolling in chat, playerlist and win-stats.
 Tachometer will now smoothly rev towards any RPM instead of instantly changing RPM.
 It is now possible to start another singleplayer game without getting a black screen.
 Bonus button choices will now show amount of gold to spend og gain.
 Turbo Blow is redone so that by holding Q your turbo produces five times more power until it has 0% health or charge left. Each turn it regains some charge depending on how much was spent.
 Tireboost is redone so that the faster you react at the start of a race the less Tireboost power you lose. Like if you react (start driving) at 0ms after the race starts then you lose 0% power. If you react at 500ms you lose 50% power. At 1000ms; 100%.
 Also, more bonuses throughout.
 Countdown timer in multiplayer at 90 sec, but no clock in singleplayer.
 Cars now start off slower.
 Victory Money and Victory Gold now provides $ and gold no matter what.
 Standard music volume now at 30% instead of 100%


Next patch: Update 5
Hopefully a more focus of the visual, but more importantly (as promised for Update 4): rework of the lobby. I'm thinking a tile based system will be interesting.. Here's a sneak peek:
